title: On the Definability of Strong Negation in Bilateral Logics
summary: Recent work in bilateral logic has concerned itself with whether and to what extent strong negation, which "toggles" between assertion and denial, is definable in bilateral systems that lack it. This paper presents a number of results about the definability of strong negation in bilateral systems. First, I show that a constructive Nelson-style Sheffer stroke defines the strong negation of A as (A|(A|A))|A.
